findings.claim: changed_pages misses a page whose source file the pull request renamed or moved

verdict.text: Both round-1 findings are fixed in b0a12607.
I also did the checks left over from round 1.
Every eval row's test asserts its row's fails_when, and the tutorial and the how-to's audit section agree with the code.
Nothing blocks, so this passes.
f1: changed_pages now runs `git diff --name-only --no-renames --relative BASE...HEAD`, and its docstring says a renamed file counts under both its old and new path.
The new test, tests/test_agent.py::test_scope_takes_a_page_whose_source_was_renamed, does a git mv and asserts that the page naming the old path is in scope with the old path as its file.
My round-1 repro shows plain `--name-only` prints only the new path, so the test fails without the flag.
f2: only one `_number` is left, at action/agent.py:200.
Eval rows: I read each row's test.
r1-r3, r4, r18: real git repos under tmp_path.
r4 uses `_never`, which raises if the model is called.
r2 also covers `.okf/decisions/index.md`.
r5, r6: exact option sets, plus a parse failure for each removed flag and for a missing --base or --pr.
r7: the tool names, from both a live run and make_tools.
r8, r9: text checks on the shipped prompt and the script header.
r10: same-repo runs; fork and Dependabot get run=false with exit 0; schedule and workflow_dispatch are refused.
r11-r13, r19: run the step scripts with a stub uv and parse the captured arguments with the real agent parser.
r14, r20: the workflow's triggers, job conditions and permissions, persist-credentials, and both commands parsed with the real parser.
r16, r17: I did not rerun these; the stamp covers them.
I ran those tests: 32 passed (tests/test_agent.py, tests/scripts/test_workflows.py) and 9 passed (packages/kmctl/tests/test_action.py).
I ran r15's grep: no match (exit 1).
Gates: I did not rerun `loopctl gate stamp`.
The coordinator asked for short commands, and the stamp at dcc6b127 is green.
Tutorial: The step 4 sed target is `records[-1]` at candidates.py:180, which matches the cited line.
ADR 0047 and the how-to name candidates.py.
ADR 0046 comes in through its `packages/kmctl/` folder source, so three pages are in scope, as the tutorial says.
The step 3 empty-report output matches render() and the run() summary text.
The step 7 how-to line 29 matches.
How-to, audit section: The refusal messages match action.yml and refuse_tokens word for word.
"No report posts nothing and passes" matches publish().
The fork and Dependabot notices match.
The input tables match action.yml's inputs and defaults.
The example workflow matches the action's needs: fetch-depth 0, persist-credentials false, the publish job alone with pull-requests: write.
f1: resolved; see Checked.
f2: resolved; see Checked.
The tutorial's opening says the line is one "two pages describe" while step 4 says three pages name it.
Both are true, because ADR 0046 names the file only through a folder source and still holds.
A reader may stumble on it, but it is not wrong.
